events.title: Jan Molby is released from prison after serving 45 days of his three-month prison sentence for motoring offences.

맨체스터 유나이티드 end their long run without a win in the First Division by beating 찰턴 애슬레틱 3–0 at Old Trafford. 노리치 시티 are still top of the First Division despite a 3–1 defeat at 애스턴 빌라, but 아스널 are three points behind them with two games in hand. 첼시 go second in the Second Division with a 3–0 win over 스토크 시티 at the Victoria Ground .

뉴캐슬 유나이티드's search for a manager ends when they recruit Jim Smith from 퀸스 파크 레인저스, who put coach Peter Shreeves in temporary charge of the first team. 아스널 miss the chance to go top of the First Division when they are held to a 1–1 draw at home to 리버풀.
Striker John Robertson returns to his native Scotland to rejoin 하트 오브 미들로디언 in a £750,000 deal after just seven months at 뉴캐슬 유나이티드.

노리치 시티 remain top of the First Division after drawing 0–0 at home with their nearest rivals 아스널. 코번트리 시티 close in on the leading pair by beating 맨체스터 유나이티드 1–0 at Highfield Road. 맨체스터 시티 go top of the Second Division with a 4–0 home win over 브래드퍼드 시티.
Uruguay's 나시오날 wins the Intercontinental Cup in FC 도쿄, Japan by defeating Dutch PSV 에인트호번 on penalties (7–6), after the match ended in 2–2.
The Merseyside derby ends in a 1–1 draw at Anfield .
루턴 타운 sign 23-year-old Northern Irish striker Iain Dowie from Isthmian League side Hendon for £30,000. 퀸스 파크 레인저스 appoint their 34-year-old former England striker Trevor Francis as player-manager.

리버풀 are now sixth in the First Division and eight points off the top of the table after losing 1–0 at home to 노리치 시티, who stay top despite 아스널's 2–1 home win over 맨체스터 유나이티드. 더비 카운티 go fourth win a 2–0 away win over 코번트리 시티. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 claim a point in their battle for survival with a 3–3 draw at home to 사우샘프턴. 밀월 remain third in the league with a 1–0 home win over 셰필드 웬즈데이.

윔블던 climb out of the bottom three with a 1–0 away win over 노팅엄 포리스트. 선덜랜드 remain within touching distance of the Second Division playoffs – and the chance of a second successive promotion – by beating Plymout Argyle 4–1 at Home Park . 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 keep up their push for automatic promotion with a 6–0 home win over 스토크 시티.
케니 샌섬 ends eight years at 아스널 by making a £300,000 move to 뉴캐슬 유나이티드.
애스턴 빌라 sell striker Garry Thompson to 왓퍼드 for £325,000.

아스널 go top of the First Division after beating 찰턴 애슬레틱 3–2 at Selhurst Park . 에버턴 go fifth win a 2–1 home win over 미들즈브러. 맨체스터 유나이티드 climb two places to ninth with a 2–0 home win over 노팅엄 포리스트. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 pick up three vital points in their fight to avoid relegation by winning 2–1 at 셰필드 웬즈데이. 리버풀 pick up three points in their bid to remain on track for the league title, beating 더비 카운티 1–0 at the Baseball Ground. 첼시 go top of the Second Division with a 3–0 home win over 입스위치 타운.

월솔, bottom of the Second Division, sack manager Tommy Coakley , their manager for two-and-a-half years, after an 11th successive league defeat. 노리치 시티 return to the top of the First Division with a 2–1 home win over 웨스트햄 유나이티드, who are now bottom of the First Division and six points adrift of safety just three seasons after coming close to winning the league title.

아스널 move to the top the First Division on goal difference from 노리치 시티 after beating 애스턴 빌라 3–0. 노리치 시티 could only manage a goalless draw at home to 미들즈브러. 윔블던 climb into 14th place with a 4–0 home win over 루턴 타운, 에버턴 go fourth win a 3–1 home win over 코번트리 시티, and 토트넘 홋스퍼 reach ninth place with a 2–0 win over 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 less than two months after being bottom of the table. The Second Division leading pair of 첼시 and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 remain level on goal difference after a 1–1 draw at Stamford Bridge . 왓퍼드 draw level on points with them after beating 본머스 1–0. 맨체스터 시티 maintain their promotion push with a 2–1 win over Swindon at the County Ground . 레스터 시티 are just four points short of the playoffs after a 4–0 home win over 블랙번 로버스. 선덜랜드 are just two points off the playoffs after beating 포츠머스 4–0 at Roker Park . 반즐리 climb into the playoff zone and are in strong contention for a place in the top flight of English football for the first time, beating struggling Shrewsbury 3–2 at Gay Meadow .
